prompts.portrait: Prepare ONE isolated transparent PIXEL RPG portrait of EXACT WISPURR from the two most recent owner reference boards. Small shy floating spirit with dark-violet flame-shaped BODY, pale cream OVAL MASK with two large indigo eyes/cyan glints and ONE indigo forehead mark. TWO pointed upward head wisps with CYAN flame tips, small arm-like side wisps, ATTACHED blue/cyan curling lower flame-tail. NO legs/feet, organic fur, wings, gear, weapons, extra mask/eyes or detached sparks. Preserve reference cute rounded proportions and subtle mystery, simple crisp pixel clusters/dark outline, palette violet/indigo/blue/cream/dark gray/cyan, readable at 37/115 px. Three-quarter FRONT facing LEFT, neutral gentle floating pose, mask readable, attached cyan lower tail curling outward. Complete entire head tips and tail inside canvas with huge empty margins. No concept board, text, labels, shadows, background, checkerboard, scene or extra objects. TRUE RGBA transparency, one complete full creature only.
prompts.combat: Create ONE production transparent battle atlas of EXACT attached WISPURR, rotated to LEFT-facing three-quarter view. Dark-violet FLAME-SHAPED FLOATING spirit, pale cream oval mask with indigo expressive eyes/cyan glints and single forehead mark, TWO upward head wisps tipped cyan, small arm-like wisps, attached blue/cyan curling lower flame-tail. NO legs/feet/fur/wings/weapons/extra faces. Same small rounded identity, simple crisp pixel RPG clusters. Strict FOUR equal columns FIVE equal rows, twenty complete isolated figures. Every full figure including head tips and tail at most 55% cell WIDTH and 60% cell HEIGHT, same body scale, centered inside equal cells with HUGE transparent margins all sides. ROW1 IDLE: quiet hover, attached tail stretches slightly, blink eyes closed, settle. ROW2 ATTACK: draw side wisps inward, lean/lower mask and curl tail, short LEFTWARD flame-body lunge with side wisps thrust, return upright neutral; no external projectile, runtime supplies elemental effect. ROW3 HIT: startled mask, backward recoil/tilt, crouch/brace curled flame, regain neutral with open eyes. ROW4 FAINT: tired eyes, mask/head droop, body collapses low with wisps lowered, FINAL rests LOW curled with eyes CLOSED and attached cyan flame dim but visible, never stands up. ROW5 CAPTURE: curious alert, shy surprise, soft cooperative tuck, calm gentle smile/closed eyes; no orb/bubble/ring. Keep pale mask and two head wisps recognizable in every pose; exact attached flames, no detached particles/stars/symbols/effects. No text/labels/grid/checkerboard/shadows/background. TRUE transparent RGBA, complete anatomy within own cell, no neighbor fragments/clipped tips/tails.

Strict FIVE equal columns EIGHT equal rows, FORTY complete isolated figures, each full head/tail/body at most 55% equal cell WIDTH and 60% equal cell HEIGHT, enormous TRANSPARENT gutters on ALL sides, centered INSIDE own cell. Each row col1 calm neutral hover; col2 tail lengthens downward and curls left, torso rises RELATIVE TO ATTACHED TAIL TIP; col3 tail shortens/body settles and slight tilt; col4 tail lengthens and curls right/body rises; col5 tail shortens/alternate settle. Attached flame deformation and torso tilt make actual hover motion even after bottom anchoring; no footsteps. Elevated 2:1 isometric camera. ROW1 NORTH directly AWAY: violet REAR body, no cream mask/eyes, two cyan head tips and lower tail. ROW2 NORTHEAST rear-right: mostly violet back, only narrow RIGHT mask edge far side, facing up-right. ROW3 EAST RIGHT PROFILE: one clear eye and cream side mask pointing RIGHT, side wisps visible. ROW4 SOUTHEAST front-right: broad mask with both eyes, facing down-right. ROW5 SOUTH symmetric FRONT toward viewer: entire oval cream mask/two eyes/central forehead mark, symmetric two upper wisps. ROW6 SOUTHWEST front-left: broad mask with both eyes facing down-left. ROW7 WEST LEFT PROFILE: one clear eye and side mask pointing LEFT. ROW8 NORTHWEST rear-left: mostly violet back, only narrow LEFT mask edge far side, facing up-left; DISTINCT from west profile. Anatomically rotate all eight, no north/front duplication. No text/labels/grid/background/checkerboard/ground shadows, no detached flame speckles or particles. True RGBA alpha, full tips/tails inside cells, zero neighbor overlap.
